title: Livingstone Advises Therapy Partner Solutions on Sale to Lee Equity Partners
主要内容: Therapy Partner Solutions (TPS) has agreed to sell its Clinic Partnerships division to Lee Equity Partners. The division operates across six states through local brands, with significant brand recognition developed over 20+ years of in-market history. TPS's experienced and cohesive senior management team, led by founders Steve Chenoweth, Sam Echols, and Chad Whitefield, will continue to lead the company as it accelerates its growth trajectory in partnership with Lee Equity. The entire senior management team, along with existing investor Walnut Grove, retained a meaningful equity investment in the business. Lee Equity Partners is targeting equity investments of $50 million to $150 million in middle-market control buyouts and growth capital financings. The companies involved have enterprise values of $100 million to $500 million and are primarily located in North America. Livingstone advised TPS on its sale to Lee Equity Partners. This transaction marks Livingstone's 269th completed since 2018 and the 33rd global healthcare transaction in the same period. The sale follows the recent sale of Foothills Therapy Partners to Confluent Health, reinforcing Livingstone's position as a leading middle-market advisor in outpatient physical therapy and rehabilitation.
